Title: Valid percent coupon applied successfully
Preconditions: User logged in; cart total meets threshold
Steps: 1. Go to Checkout 2. Enter coupon code 3. Click Áp dụng
Notes: Covers C1-C5 all satisfied; validates percent formula

Title: Valid fixed-amount coupon applied successfully
Preconditions: User logged in; cart total meets threshold
Steps: 1. Go to Checkout 2. Enter coupon code 3. Click Áp dụng

Title: Valid coupon with remaining uses (multi-use code)
Preconditions: User logged in; user has used VIP100 0 times (max_uses_per_user = 2)
Notes: Confirms C5 passes when usage count is below the cap

Title: Non-existent coupon code (C1 fails)
Steps: Enter a code that does not exist in the DB, click Áp dụng
Expected_Result: couponError shown (e.g. 'Không thể áp dụng mã'); no discount applied; final total unchanged

Title: Expired coupon rejected (C2 fails)
Preconditions: User logged in; total meets the code's own min_order_amount
Steps: Enter EXPIRED code (min_order_amount = 100,000 ₫, expired_at = 2020-01-01), click Áp dụng
Notes: Isolates C2 (còn hạn sử dụng) - threshold intentionally satisfied so only expiry can fail it

Title: Order total below coupon's minimum threshold (C3 fails)
Preconditions: User logged in; SAVE10 requires total >= 300,000 ₫
Steps: Set cart/edit total to 200,000 ₫, enter SAVE10, click Áp dụng

Title: Guest user attempts to apply a coupon (C4 fails)
Preconditions: User is NOT logged in (no JWT token); total meets threshold
Steps: As a guest, enter SAVE10 and click Áp dụng
Expected_Result: Request rejected / couponError shown; discount NOT applied

Title: Coupon already used the maximum number of times (C5 fails)
Preconditions: User logged in; user has already used SAVE10 once (max_uses_per_user = 1)
Steps: Re-apply SAVE10 a 2nd time as the same user
Expected_Result: couponError shown (e.g. 'đã dùng hết lượt'); discount NOT applied

Title: Boundary - total exactly equal to min_order_amount
Steps: Set total to exactly 500,000 ₫, apply BIGBUY
Notes: Validates the >= boundary explicitly, not just >

Title: Boundary - total one unit below min_order_amount
Notes: One VND below the boundary must fail C3

Title: Coupon code entered in lowercase
Preconditions: User logged in; total meets threshold
Expected_Result: Coupon accepted and treated identically to SAVE10 (frontend uppercases before sending); final_amount = 270,000 ₫

Title: Coupon code with leading/trailing whitespace
Preconditions: User logged in; total meets threshold
Steps: Type the code with extra spaces around it, click Áp dụng
Expected_Result: Coupon accepted (frontend trims before sending); final_amount = 270,000 ₫

Title: Tampered total_amount used to fraudulently satisfy threshold
Preconditions: User logged in; REAL cart value is only 100,000 ₫ (below SAVE10's 300,000 ₫ threshold)
Steps: 1. Manually overwrite the editable 'Tổng tiền thanh toán' field to 350,000 ₫ (real cart is 100,000 ₫) 2. Apply SAVE10 3. Proceed to Xác Nhận Thanh Toán
Expected_Result: Coupon apply call may succeed client-side (known defect - see FR-08 total-tampering issue), BUT the backend checkout endpoint must recompute the real total from the cart and reject/ignore the fabricated total_amount
Notes: Directly tests the FR-08/FR-09 integrity gap - editableTotal is user-controlled input to the coupon threshold check

Title: Empty coupon code - submit blocked client-side
Steps: Leave coupon input blank, observe Áp dụng button
Expected_Result: Áp dụng button remains disabled; no API request is sent; no coupon result/error rendered

Title: Multi-use coupon exceeds its own usage cap (C5 fails on 3rd use)
Preconditions: User logged in; user has already used VIP100 exactly 2 times (max_uses_per_user = 2)
Steps: Attempt to apply VIP100 a 3rd time as the same user
Notes: Confirms C5 cap is enforced per-user, not just once
